label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness) is TP: Line 96 generates 'rememberMeKey' using java.util.Random.nextGaussian(), which is cryptographically insecure for session tokens. The resolved sink value is attacker-controllable random data used for authentication persistence. Alert 2 (java/xss) is also TP: User-supplied cookie values ('param') are written unsanitized to the HTTP response body (Lines 105-110), enabling XSS.

evidence.note: Insecure randomness source: java.util.Random.nextGaussian() used to generate rememberMeKey
XSS sink: User-provided cookie value written directly to response.getWriter() without sanitization
